faqAdsA: In iOS version 1.1.1 and later, live guides, photo and video capture, and My Looks are free. A locally bundled banner promotes Nonlate. An optional annual subscription removes promotional banners. The App Store shows your localized price and any eligible trial before purchase. Older versions may require a subscription for camera access; update to use the free camera.
faqPrivacyQ: How do I manage my subscription and privacy choices?
faqPrivacyA: Manage or cancel your subscription through the App Store, or use Manage Subscription in PartMirror Settings. Restore Purchases checks your Apple Account for banner-removal access. You can revoke Photos permission in iOS Settings and delete saved looks inside PartMirror.
privacyIntro: This policy covers PartMirror on iPhone and iPad, including the free-camera edition from iOS version 1.1.1, earlier subscription-only and advertising-enabled editions, and this website.
privacyCollectionBody: The free-camera edition uses a locally bundled Nonlate promotional banner, with no advertising SDK or external ad request. PartMirror does not collect banner impressions or clicks on a server. Camera images, face geometry, saved looks, names and part settings are not transmitted to us or an advertising provider. Tapping the banner opens the Nonlate App Store listing; Apple processes that store visit under its privacy policy. This website has no advertising or analytics trackers. GitHub Pages hosts it and may process ordinary network requests under its own privacy policy.
privacyAdsTitle: Local promotion and older advertising editions
privacyAdsBody: From iOS version 1.1.1, PartMirror displays its own locally bundled Nonlate banner and an optional banner-removal offer. No Google AdMob or Google consent SDK is included, no external advertising is requested, and banner interactions are not sent to our servers. Verified banner-removal subscribers see neither banner. Earlier subscription-only versions also contain no advertising SDK. Older advertising-enabled versions may still use Google AdMob and Google's consent tools, which may process an IP address, device identifiers, advertising data, product interactions, performance data and diagnostics. Camera images, face geometry, saved looks and part settings are never provided for advertising. Where available in an older version, use its Settings to manage ad privacy choices.
privacyPurchasesBody: Apple processes purchases, billing, refunds and subscription management. From iOS version 1.1.1, PartMirror reads Apple-verified subscription status only to remove or restore promotional banners, not to unlock the camera. Earlier subscription-only editions use that status for app access. Existing annual subscribers retain banner-removal benefits while their entitlement is valid. PartMirror has no account system or payment-card storage.
termsSubscriptionBody: In iOS version 1.1.1 and later, live guides, photo and video capture, and My Looks are free; an annual subscription is optional and removes promotional banners. The U.S. annual reference price is US$9.99. The current localized App Store price and any eligible offer shown before purchase control; existing subscriber pricing may differ. A seven-day trial is available only if Apple confirms eligibility and shows it on the purchase sheet. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase, or after an offered trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Cancellation preserves banner-removal benefits until the paid period ends, unless Apple refunds or revokes access. Restore Purchases is in PartMirror Settings; manage or cancel through your Apple Account. Apple billing, grace-period, refund and revocation rules apply. Earlier subscription-only app versions may require a subscription for camera access; update to use the free camera.
storeIntro: Live guides, capture and My Looks are free. PartMirror displays a Nonlate promotional banner. An optional annual subscription removes banners; the App Store shows your localized price and any eligible trial before purchase. Renews annually until cancelled. Manage or cancel in App Store subscription settings.
storeWhatsNew: Use live hair-part guides, photo and video capture, and My Looks for free. A Nonlate promotional banner replaces the subscription entry paywall. Banner removal is an optional annual subscription. Camera tracking and guide accuracy are unchanged.
storePromo: Preview hair parts with live guides. Capture and compare your looks for free. Optional annual subscription removes promotional banners.
